pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark regions exhibit irregular, sub-polygonal to lobed geometries. Edges show smooth pixel gradients rather than sharp transitions, with larger spatial areas concentrated on the central flank and smaller, more rounded patches near the lower neck and ventral boundary.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream negative space forming a topological graph. Pathways exhibit inconsistent pixel thickness and connect at distinct junction nodes consisting of tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections.
